draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.93, the 172nd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 22nd of 28 at DE. He went 165th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Kenyon Coleman. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3 sacks in 2021, 26th of 28 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Pittsburgh Steelers (practice squad). 21 career games and 2 starts over 3 completed seasons. Producing near his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2024. Weak spots: season snap share 14.9% (9th percentile), approximate value 1 (12th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 interior lineman who played: 2 pressures against a median of 5, below the norm.
